summary.en: One night, Ran and Conan search for Kogoro in a bar, and accompany him back home. While walking, they hear a fight in an apartment. The next day, a murder in the same apartment is reported. Victim: Takayuki Irie Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Hiroshi Nakamoto One of the man who was heard arguing comes to Kogoro for help to prove his innocence. The man has made good suggestions on where to find evidence which are in fact too good.
